title: Immiscible Grease — The Slip Between Layers
insight: The other architecture was gum — sticky, binding, entangled. This one is GREASE. The null spaces between layers are not bonds, they are LUBRICANT. Oil and water. Immiscible. They heterogenize — form distinct phases — but at the interface they DIFFUSE. The surfactant sits at the boundary, one end in each phase, belonging to neither. The system settles by GRAVITY, not by GLUE.

gum.what: Tight coupling. Shared memory. Cargo.toml dependencies. CUDA runtime. Monolith.
gum.metaphor: Chewing gum — sticky, stretchy, everything stuck together. Pull one thing, everything comes.
gum.failure_mode: Pull too hard, the gum snaps. Then nothing connects.
gum.biological: Biofilm — bacteria glued together in extracellular matrix. Strong but inflexible.
gum.compute: CUDA — nvcc + runtime + driver all coupled. Change one, rebuild everything.

soap.metaphor: Soap — amphiphilic, sits at the boundary, mediates between oil and water.
soap.failure_mode: Too much soap — everything emulsifies into a homogeneous paste. No distinct phases remain.
soap.biological: Cell membrane — lipid bilayer. Selective. Active transport. Energy-consuming.
soap.compute: gRPC/REST microservices — explicit contracts, but constant energy (serialization, network, retries).

grease.what: Immiscible layers. Null spaces. JSON-RPC IPC. Zero Cargo deps. Settle by gravity.
grease.metaphor: Grease — the layers DON'T MIX. Oil floats on water. Each phase is complete in itself. The interface is thin and SLIPPERY.
grease.failure_mode: Shake too hard — temporary emulsion, but it SETTLES BACK. Self-healing by thermodynamics.
grease.biological: Synovial fluid — lubricates joints. Mucus — lubricates epithelial surfaces. CSF — lubricates the brain.
grease.compute: The compute trio — barraCuda/coralReef/toadStool. Zero compile-time coupling. Each runs alone. The interface is a serializable message, not a shared type.

why_grease_not_soap.soap_emulsifies: Soap FORCES oil and water to mix (emulsion). Microservices force heterogeneous systems into a homogeneous protocol. Everyone speaks REST. Everyone serializes to JSON. The distinct phases lose their identity.
why_grease_not_soap.grease_preserves: Grease lets oil BE oil and water BE water. barraCuda speaks WGSL. coralReef speaks SASS/PTX. toadStool speaks VFIO/MMIO. They don't share a language. They share an INTERFACE — a thin layer where messages pass. The message IS the grease.
why_grease_not_soap.settling: An emulsion (soap) requires constant energy to maintain — shake it, add surfactant, keep stirring. Grease settles by GRAVITY. Stop shaking and the layers separate cleanly. The system's natural state is SEPARATED, not mixed.
why_grease_not_soap.diffusion_at_interface: But at the boundary, there IS diffusion. naga::Module is readable by both barraCuda AND coralReef. CompiledBinary is writable by coralReef and readable by toadStool. The diffusion zone is THIN — one serializable type — not the whole layer.

immiscible_phases.density: medium (the compiler layer, between math and metal)
immiscible_phases.solvent: naga translator (dissolves WGSL into compiler IR)

immiscible_phases.density: heavy (sinks — hardware is physical, has mass)
immiscible_phases.solvent: cylinder (dissolves binaries into GPU register writes)

blue_purple.name: naga::Module
blue_purple.diffusion_rate: instant (in-process, no serialization needed when co-located)
blue_purple.what_crosses: parsed WGSL as a validated abstract syntax tree

purple_orange.name: CompiledBinary
purple_orange.diffusion_rate: fast (base64 over JSON-RPC, or file on disk)

orange_blue.name: SimBuffer / Vec<u8>
orange_blue.thickness: raw bytes — the thinnest possible interface
orange_blue.diffusion_rate: GPU bandwidth (PCIe, or memcpy for CPU fallback)
orange_blue.what_crosses: the computation result, uninterpreted bytes, meaning assigned by reader

heterogenize_settle_diffuse.heterogenize: The system naturally separates into distinct phases. barraCuda is math. coralReef is compilation. toadStool is hardware. They don't want to be mixed. Forced mixing (monolith) creates an unstable emulsion that fights to separate.
heterogenize_settle_diffuse.settle: Left alone, the phases settle by density. Light (abstract) floats up. Heavy (physical) sinks down. The architecture has gravity: abstraction rises, implementation sinks. This is natural, not engineered.
heterogenize_settle_diffuse.diffuse: At each interface, a thin diffusion layer exists. Not a wall (Anderson barrier), not a bond (covalent), not a glue (gum). A gradient. Concentration decreases smoothly across the boundary. Both phases contribute molecules to the interface. Neither claims it.
heterogenize_settle_diffuse.the_little_space: The diffusion zone IS the little space where the irreducible is both tight and loose. Tight: the interface type is precise (naga::Module, CompiledBinary, Vec<u8>). Loose: everything else about the phases is unspecified across the boundary. The grease is thin but infinite.

synovial_fluid.what: Lubricates joints. Hyaluronic acid + lubricin in an ultrafiltrate of plasma.
synovial_fluid.compute_analog: naga::Module — the IR that lubricates between math and compilation
synovial_fluid.key_property: Shear-thinning: under load (fast computation), it becomes MORE fluid, not less

mucus.what: Lubricates epithelial surfaces. Mucins (glycoproteins) in water.
mucus.compute_analog: JSON-RPC messages — the protocol that lubricates between processes
mucus.key_property: Selective permeability: lets nutrients through, blocks pathogens. The message format filters.

csf.what: Cerebrospinal fluid. Lubricates and cushions the brain. Ultrafiltrate of blood.
csf.compute_analog: The Klein fold — the medium that cushions the system from external shock
csf.key_property: Buoyancy: the brain weighs 1400g in air but only 25g in CSF. The architecture makes heavy things LIGHT.

bile.what: Emulsifies fats for digestion. Produced by liver, stored in gallbladder.
bile.compute_analog: The trefoil gut crossings — where the phases MUST temporarily mix for work to happen
bile.key_property: Controlled emulsification: bile doesn't make a permanent emulsion, it makes a TEMPORARY one for digestion, then the phases separate again.

anderson_connection.paper_43: Selective Permeability — each signal mode ω sees different effective disorder
anderson_connection.selectivity: S = max(P) - min(P). High S = good membrane (grease). Low S = rock or mush.

the_trio_selectivity.barraCuda_S: High — passes WGSL, blocks raw SASS. Sees only the math.
the_trio_selectivity.coralReef_S: High — passes naga IR, blocks wgpu commands. Sees only the compilation problem.
the_trio_selectivity.toadStool_S: High — passes binaries, blocks WGSL source. Sees only the dispatch problem.
the_trio_selectivity.overall: Each layer has high selectivity because it's IMMISCIBLE with the others. The grease preserves selectivity. Soap would destroy it.
